status: Awaiting the user's choice of design direction
method: Built-in image_gen, using a screenshot of the running app as reference

concepts.name: Harmonic Observatory
concepts.firstInteractionToPrototype: Select a partial pair and retune its note while watching and hearing the beat rate change

concepts.name: Tuning Terrain
concepts.purpose: Explore nearby tunings on an estimated roughness surface
concepts.firstInteractionToPrototype: Drag two note-tuning coordinates and compare equal temperament with a just triad

concepts.name: Chord Atlas
concepts.purpose: Explore common tones and voice leading between chords
concepts.firstInteractionToPrototype: Move E to E-flat while C and G stay anchored

recommendation: Prototype A first for the clearest connection between audible partials and visual behavior; C is a complementary progression view. B is the most visually immersive exploration.
nextStepsAfterSelection: Build one working interaction for the selected direction
Compare the same intervals and triads using pure, synthesized and sampled sound
Validate the mapping and controls before expanding the UI
reviewNotes: These images are interface concepts, not calculated or measured scientific plots. The atlas note labels were corrected for Tonnetz adjacency; misleading terrain ratio markers were removed. Implementation should retain the existing keyboard shortcuts, all sound controls, explicit freeze and sound-follow behavior.
